model.identical_to: Xin-Rui/BudgetThinker-Training-Stage-Model@f07bbaff:TCMv4_8ratio_v1_step_421_reward_0.838-models/model.safetensors (RL checkpoint; the SFT-only checkpoint TCMv4_8ratio_FULL_1_5B_6epoch has a different hash)
model.run_dtype: bfloat16 on bf16-capable GPUs (A100, compute capability >= 8.0); float16 on T4
model.run_dtype_reason: bfloat16 is the published dtype; NVIDIA T4 (sm_75) has no native bfloat16, so the 10-question T4 run used float16

dataset.note: Identical problems/answers to the repo's evaluation/data/math500 (repo adds the 'Return your final response within \boxed{}. ' prefix, which official_prompt adds too)

conditions.A: No external control tokens (official remaining=default); model may emit control tokens itself
conditions.B: Official BudgetThinker injection, K=8: delta=B//8+1, 7/8..1/8 overwrite the sampled token

sampling.note: Extended setting requested by the study. The official sampling script passes top_p=0.95 but process_chunk hard-codes top_p=0.9.

seeds: seed = sha256(run|q_uid|budget|sample_idx)[:63 bits]; shared by A and B (common random numbers); one CPU torch.Generator per generation

termination.reasoning_cap: B + B//50 generated tokens before </think> (official stage-1 max_tokens)
termination.natural_over_budget: model emits </think> with B < reasoning_tokens <= B + B//50
termination.forced: cap reached without </think>: append official suffix, then <= 50 answer tokens

token_counting.reasoning_tokens: all generated tokens before </think>: <think>, text, injected and self-generated control tokens

pilot.pick: first selected question of each level

colab.gpu: T4 (pilot, 10-question run); A100 (full 100-question run, approved by the user 2026-10-11)
colab.cu_rate_note: verify in Colab > Resources; the estimate cell takes the rate as a parameter
